amendment_note: Reports absolute Fourier level weights of the conditional next-token function. Retracts the discarded sparse zero-extension attempt. Uses saved cross-fitted degree-0/1/2 projection risks and exact planted spectra; no learner or profile recomputation.

target.excluded_wrong_target: zero-extended graph of isolated empirical 64-byte contexts

spectrum.basis: Formula-(19) categorical function spans, Gram-orthonormalized in degree order
spectrum.finite_sample_rule: cross-fitted risks; monotonize nested risks only when estimation noise reverses them

scope.natural: strongest pair among the ten frozen lag pairs; a lower-dimensional spectral slice, not the complete 64-position spectrum
scope.synthetic: exact planted conditional spectrum is primary; pair estimate is retained as estimator diagnostics

correlator.difficulty: median normalized learning-curve area; higher is harder
correlator.natural_inference: descriptive only with two natural corpora
